daily.today_energy: The cosmic vibes are calling you inward today, Pisces. This is your moment to sit with yourself and listen to what your intuition's been trying to say. Trust the quiet.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether it's deepening an existing connection or a new spark, the universe is nudging you toward honest conversations.
daily.career: Your creative instincts are on fire right now. This is the energy to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or take a different angle on something that's been stuck. Your vibe is contagious.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Prioritize rest over hustle—journaling, a slow walk, or just being still can do wonders for your nervous system. Listen to what feels nourishing.

weekly.overview: Mercury's dancing through your zone of creativity this week, Pisces. Your intuition is basically your superpower rn—trust those gut feelings even if they seem random. Energy's shifting toward authenticity, so lean into what actually feels real to you.
weekly.love: Venus is giving soft, vulnerable energy. If you're coupled up, this is perfect for those deep convos you've been avoiding. Single? Someone might slide into your orbit who actually gets your vibe. Either way, don't dim your light to make space for anyone.
weekly.career: Your natural empathy is literally your competitive edge this week. A project or collaboration could gain momentum if you lead with clarity instead of overthinking. Trust your weird ideas—they're usually the ones that land.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for slowness. This isn't laziness; it's wisdom. Gentle movement, hydration, and actually sleeping are your real MVPs. Your nervous system's been running hot—give it permission to reset without guilt.
